name: Majokko Tricolor
original_name: 魔女っ娘とりこロール
source:
Takuya is a cult maniac. One day, when he tests some magic, three girls suddenly appear in front of him! It seems they will need to sexually satisfy him to go back to their world. Girls reluctantly accepts it.... It's time for Takuya to blast off his sexual desire!
